Who We Are

YOUR FIRE SAFETY PARTNER

Engineering Fire Service Corporation has been operating since 2016, based in Patna, Bihar. We are a leading supplier and installer of comprehensive fire protection systems — covering all types of manual and automatic fire extinguishers, clean agent systems, fire modular units, and more.

Our team of 50+ qualified professionals is dedicated to delivering the best quality products and achieving utmost customer satisfaction. We co-ordinate closely with clients to deliver user-specified fire fighting and protection services reliably and on time.

We also provide Fire Safety Signboards, Emergency Evacuation Plans, Emergency Lighting, and all-round fire protection consultancy — acting as both Contractor and Consultant for all types of fire fighting services across Bihar and Jharkhand.

What We Do

OUR CORE SERVICES

01 💧

Fire Suppression System

Complete design, supply and installation using clean agents, foam, CO₂ and dry chemical powder for total coverage.

02 🔔

Fire Alarm System

Advanced alarm systems with smoke detectors, heat detectors, manual call points and control panels.

03 🚿

Hydrant & Sprinkler System

Design and installation for complete building coverage — ideal for commercial and residential complexes.

04 🧯

Fire Extinguisher Supply

ABC, CO₂, Foam, Water CO₂, AFFF and Dry Chemical Powder — both manual and automatic variants.

05 🔄

Refilling & Maintenance

24×7 on-call refilling, inspection and maintenance for all fire fighting equipment with safety reports.

06 🚨

Emergency Planning

Evacuation plan creation, emergency lighting, fire safety signage and fire awareness training programs.

What We Supply

FIRE SAFETY PRODUCTS

🧯

ABC Fire Extinguisher

Multi-purpose dry chemical powder for Class A, B & C fires.

❄️

CO₂ Extinguisher

Clean, residue-free — ideal for electrical & server rooms.

🤖

Automatic Fire Extinguisher

Sprinkler-tech self-activating unit for ATM centres & server rooms. No external support needed.

🧼

Clean Agent Extinguisher

Zero residue — perfect for sensitive equipment & data centres.

🌊

AFFF Foam Extinguisher

Mechanical foam for liquid (Class B) & solid fuel fires.

📦

Fire Modular System

HFC-227 suppression modules for total flooding protection.

🔊

Smoke Detectors & Alarms

Ionisation and photoelectric detectors, heat sensors & alarm panels.

🪧

Fire Safety Signage

Standard fire safety boards, emergency lights & evacuation markers.
